said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

Closing this loophole was overdue, but is still not enough. We need serious export https://t.co/eiQrvWK2Du

This morning, I was proud to vote YES on the Major Richard Star Act to ensure medically retired veterans receive their full retired pay and disability compensation. Despite Republican leadership’s efforts to block this bill, House Democrats forced a vote through a discharge petition. 

Our veterans have waited far too long for the benefits they’ve earned. I urge the Senate to quickly get this bill across the finish line.
When Democrats regain control of Congress in January, I will be working to reverse the cuts to research budgets and begin rebuilding our scientific enterprise.

On Veterans Day, we thank our brave men and women in uniform for the sacrifices they've made for our country. Veterans answered the call to protect our nation and defend our freedom. 

We are forever grateful for their service and sacrifice.

I will be voting for the bipartisan resolution to impeach Pete Hegseth. 

He has been a failure as Secretary of Defense from the start. The war in Iran has achieved no strategic goals, and Americans and our service members have paid the price. Hegseth must be removed.

It was a pleasure to attend and speak at The Open Source in Finance Forum (OSFF) New York 2026 hosted by the Fintech Open Source Foundation.

I spoke about how technology like AI can make our financial system more efficient, promote stability, and protect consumers. As Congress begins a new session, we must prioritize the safety of our financial system and support responsible innovation.

On Tuesday, the American people sent a message loud and clear that they need relief from rising costs. 

Officials in the corrupt Trump administration, and their friends, have made millions while working families are footing the bill. Democrats in both the House and the Senate are ready to get to work, lower costs, and hold this administration accountable.

When we get back to DC, we need to hit the ground running on protecting Americans and our financial system against AI risk. 

Unlike Republican leadership, with @RepJeffries, we will finally have a Speaker who understands Congress needs to get off the sidelines.
